name: check_inputs
description: Diff inputs/ against inputs.json (size and sha256). The manifest is validated whole first: a malformed entry, a duplicate path, a regular file with no size or no sha256 (a size-only check is not a verification) are reported, never skipped. A file that cannot be opened is unreadable, one not reached before the time budget is not_checked, and neither passes. Links are checked by their target and pipes, sockets and devices by their kind. Every file's result is written, as it is checked, to a receipts file of its own for this run. A directory under inputs/ that cannot be listed is unreadable. Returns modified, missing, added and checked as before, plus malformed, duplicates, digest_missing, unreadable, not_checked and bytes_hashed. A pass means agreement with the baseline: it does not show the evidence is authentic or complete. This is the pack tool's receipt; the harness's own inputs_check event is written by the harness at completion, not by this tool. In a job it reads the copy of the run's inputs.json the job service gives a job that sees all of inputs/ (SWARM_INPUTS_MANIFEST); a job with a narrower scope, or a manifest past the job service's size limit, gets none, and the tool says so.

max_seconds.description: Hashing budget in seconds (default 1500, at most 1700, inside the tool's own 1800 second limit); files not reached are reported as not_checked and the run fails
